name: IMO-Bench
intro: IMO-AnswerBench是一个高级数学推理基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛级别问题上的表现。它包含400个多样化的奥林匹克问题，这些问题具有可验证的简短答案。该基准测试在推动模型数学推理能力方面发挥了关键作用。
intro_en: IMO-AnswerBench is an advanced mathematical reasoning benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on International Mathematical Olympiad-level problems. It contains 400 diverse Olympiad questions with verifiable short answers. This benchmark plays a key role in advancing models' mathematical reasoning abilities.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.01846. IMO-Bench contains IMO-AnswerBench, IMO-Proof Bench, and IMO-GradingBench. IMO-AnswerBench handpicks 400 Olympiad problems across algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory, robustifies them by paraphrasing, renaming objects, changing values, and adding distractors, and uses AnswerAutoGrader based on Gemini 2.5 Pro to extract and verify short answers. IMO-Proof Bench contains 60 proof problems split into basic and advanced subsets; the advanced set includes 18 novel problems crafted by IMO medalists plus recent competition problems. Human experts use 0-7 IMO-style grades. IMO-GradingBench contains 1,000 model solutions with expert grades mapped to Correct, Almost, Partial, and Incorrect. ProofAutoGrader is validated against expert labels and is recommended as an augmentation to human verification.
